question: Should entry be given in advance, and should the negligence-entered be considered?
premises: entry here is not to be given beforehand to anyone at all
but of the negligence-entered, consideration should indeed not be discussed
inference: Advance entry is refused to all; the negligence-entered get no deliberation.
plain_english: Entry here is not to be given, before indeed, to anyone — but of the negligence-entered, consideration indeed should not be discussed.
